description: Defines the Label class used for representing target names and paths in a build system, including methods for resolution, comparison, and formatting.

classes.name: Label
classes.description: Represents a build target label with path, name, and toolchain information, supporting resolution, comparison, and formatting.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a string from a build file into a fully qualified Label, handling relative paths and errors.

methods.name: GetToolchainLabel
methods.description: Returns the label representing the toolchain.

methods.name: GetWithNoToolchain
methods.description: Returns a copy of the label with an empty toolchain.

methods.name: GetUserVisibleName
methods.description: Formats the label for user display, optionally including the toolchain.
